legend.1: Negligible: routine, low-risk, mechanical, or reversible; a wrong call costs little and is easy to undo.
legend.2: Moderate: some risk or rework, but bounded and recoverable.
legend.3: High: material consequences for correctness, security, cost, user trust, or irreversibility.
